statements.status_notes: The adpcmdec element does not validate the per-block sample count for multi-channel IMA/DVI ADPCM streams, so a crafted WAV file can write past the output buffer. gst-plugins-bad1.0 is part of the WebKit media dependency set that upstream Playwright's install-deps mandates for Debian 13. Upstream fixed this in GStreamer 1.28.6 and Debian carries the fix only in unstable (1.28.6-1); trixie ships 1.26.2-3+deb13u2, so no fixed package is available for Debian 13 yet. Whether Playwright-driven WebKit sessions can route untrusted ADPCM audio to adpcmdec is under investigation.
